theme: Clean & light modern fintech (Light Theme primarily)
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Fintech precision)

headings.style: Clean, authoritative but approachable. Tracking tight on large headings.

body.style: Legible, clean, strictly using tabular-nums for all financial data to prevent jumping.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento style: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 inside structural cards. Avoid cramped data.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Right-align all numeric columns in tables. Left-align text. Use flex-row justify-between for key/value pairs.

surfaces_and_components.cards: Cardless or flat solid surfaces. bg-white, border border-slate-200, rounded-2xl, shadow-sm. NO heavy drop shadows.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Sharp hover states with slight opacity or color shift.
surfaces_and_components.tables: Simple, no heavy borders. 1px bottom border on rows. Tabular numerals (tabular-nums) are MANDATORY.
surfaces_and_components.navigation: Narrow left sidebar (collapsed) or clean top navigation with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) if sticky.
surfaces_and_components.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Use soft colors, hide grid lines or make them very faint (slate-100). Keep charts low-contrast so text stays primary.

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y-[-2px] or bg color shifts. transition-all is FORBIDDEN. Use specific transitions like transition-colors, transition-transform.

visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for standard UI, @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone) for high-end dashboard feel.
visual_enhancers.data_display: One dominant financial figure per page (e.g., Net Worth). Use small trend indicators (green/red pills).

login_background.description: Soft flowing waves in shades of cream, peach, and light orange. Use for auth page split screen.

user_avatar.description: Closeup photography of woman smiling. Use for dummy user profile picture.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Check gray text carefully.
accessibility.interactive: Hover states must have higher contrast or clear color shift. data-testid attributes are MANDATORY for all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build out the 28-tab equivalent using a modern SPA routing setup with grouped nested routes.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to remove the 'default Vercel' look (use Manrope font, softer borders).
All financial metrics MUST use `tabular-nums` class.
Do not use generic 'Dashboard' layouts. Use the Bento Grid for the All-in-one Dashboard.
For the AI Insights panel, create a clean conversational UI with distinct user/AI bubbles, using the brand accent color for AI.
Avoid full screen gradients. Keep the background solid slate-50.
Provide a robust data mocking strategy for the transaction tables and charts so they look populated and realistic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons instead.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (p-6, p-8, p-12).
Always use sonner for toasts (located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Ensure 100% of the interactive UI uses standard HTML attributes (e.g. data-testid) for automated testing.
Use .js files for React components, not .tsx.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
